lesson: Widening inclusion scale to 0.3-0.8 was the winning final-round lever (inclusion 0.352→0.407, mAP 0.612→0.633), confirming mid-size coverage matters as much as the small end. prefer_small (even scoped to inclusion only) keeps destabilizing scratches, and high max_overlap (0.30) destroys inclusion AP — avoid both. If iterating further, the scale band is the productive knob; allocation and source-size selection are exhausted.
